codex_instructions: Import this file into the existing product schema; adapt field names to the repository.
Upsert by source_site + source_product_id; preserve source IDs and URLs as provenance.
Use rewritten description for customer-facing copy. Preserve source categories for audit; use primary_category and categories for navigation. Products may belong to several categories.
Prices are GBP decimal pounds. price_type=from means a minimum or range, not the price of the titled complete set. Use variant prices for selected options. Never invent missing prices.
Keep source catalogues separate. Do not automatically merge products with similar names or choose the cheaper source price. Review duplicate_candidates first.
Create draft products where import_status=draft. Resolve review_flags before publishing. Do not import source reviews, supplier contact details, warranty or delivery claims as your own policies.
Download authorised product images into the website image service rather than relying on permanent external hotlinks. Gallery images do not establish separately purchasable colour variants.
Retain accessories under Armchairs or Footstools; do not classify them as sofas.
Global source fabric catalogue is reference-only; confirm seller availability and pricing before attaching those options to your products.
Do not delete existing products. Generate a validation report with counts by category, unresolved fields, duplicates and image failures.
